subject: pig (local-wilding mascot)
notes: typed construction spec for render_audit --spec. Regions are fractions of the SUBJECT bbox [y0,x0,y1,x1] so they survive canvas/scale changes. The 2026-11-10 blob lesson: a merged pig is not fewer mask components (v2 had 7, same as v3) - it is fewer INTERIOR features; spec checks therefore look at color-key diversity and named-region solidity, not raw component counts. midtone = non-dominant-body color key with all quantized channels >=3 (nostril dots are dark (1,1,2) and do not count - the snout is a mid-tone oval ring).
